information.description:
When Militech needs an op to be done clean, quietly, and with as few witnesses as possible, they task Commandos to it. They are ruthlessly trained on their assignments, and are unlikely (if ever) out on patrol for a random reason. Commandos sport a truckload of cyberware and the skills to make use of them, all favoring a discreet, nimble fighting style.

From Corgo's 77 Collection: Mooks by Corgopolis (Militech).

description.value: Experts in combat who use their fighting prowess to dominate in the lawless time of the Red.
Throwing hands, does ignore half armor.
A knife fit for the streets.

The preferred pistol among Night City cops – light, wieldy, and easy on the recoil, it's perfect for taking down enemies without necessarily killing them on the spot. Thanks to its relatively small dimensions, the gun has also found a loyal following among those who prefer a concealed carry: the Lexington easily fits in a coat pocket or purse. And for design lovers, its classic 2030s frame remains stunning as ever.

Cost: 750eb (Expensive)

Class: Heavy Pistol • Skill: Handgun • Range: Pistol

Damage: 3d6 • Capacity: 21 • ROF: 2 • Hands: 1

Alt. Firing Modes: Autofire (Machine Pistol 3), Suppressive Fire

Concealable: Yes

Run the edge at top speed, choomba. There ain’t another way to live.

Speedware. As an Action, the user may activate this cyberware, after which it remains active for the next 60 seconds (20 Rounds). While active, this cyberware provides a +3 bonus to any Initiative Roll made. If activated while the user is already in an Initiative Queue, their current Initiative increases by 3, which is lost if this cyberware deactivates or its duration expires during combat. This cyberware has a 1 hour cooldown before it can be activated again. Only 1 piece of Speedware can be installed at a time.

Type: Neuralware
Install: Clinic
Option Slots: uses 1

Foundry notes:

  • Replaces the core system's Sandevistan; use this one instead of the core item.
  • Matches the core item's setup: the +3 shows as a toggle in the initiative roll dialog.
